title: Q-ROOT-edit-hotspot: edit-hotspot keeps recurring: Make the value computed or the file append-only, so one change no longer rewrites it; the hotspot closes when its edits fall to baseline.
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** the daily failure audit files it when a root cause recurs; the executor takes it in driver order
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation rootcause --probe edit-hotspot
**Status:** closed

Root cause class `edit-hotspot` recurred on 2 days (2026-11-21, 2026-11-22); the guard exists and the failure still returned: the guard is ineffective, so redesign it (a fourth attempt of the same fix is not allowed).
Root cause: a file is rewritten by every change: either hand-kept state that should be computed or appended, or generated output the hotspot score counted as work (temporal now reads scripts/regen_generated.py OUTPUTS, one list, so a generator cannot be flagged)
Guard: `grep:foundation/temporal.py::hotspot`
Remedy: Make the value computed or the file append-only, so one change no longer rewrites it; the hotspot closes when its edits fall to baseline.
Symptoms seen:
- failure-audit:temporal-drift: temporal-drift a hotspot, neglected area, stopped loop or repeated failure stood in the series for several runs and noth
- temporal:e0c6ffc24a: area:root 154 commits in 3 days against a baseline of 11.4 a day (4.5x)
- temporal:c200e5281e: file:README.md README.md edited 147 times in 3 days (outside generated and ledger paths)
- temporal:1b91492bbf: file:doctrine/decision-ledger.json doctrine/decision-ledger.json edited 81 times in 3 days (outside generated and ledger
- temporal:67dd9b9dee: file:platform/adapters/README.md platform/adapters/README.md edited 37 times in 3 days (outside generated and ledger pat
- temporal:593c3b95f2: file:seed/worker/src/index.js seed/worker/src/index.js edited 21 times in 3 days (outside generated and ledger paths)
Fix the root, not the symptom: the item closes when the guard passes and the class stays quiet for 2 days.

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation rootcause --probe edit-hotspot

**Disposition:** shelved (executor-failed, 2026-11-22T18:01:41Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** the executor failed 3 consecutive runs on this item; last reason: RuntimeError: checks failed after 3 attempts: the reply was not valid JSON with a files list: RuntimeError: every code agent rung failed: github-models-llama: RuntimeError: non-JSON response (HTTP 200, text/plain) from https://models.github. Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
